title: 產科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋產前照護與篩檢、妊娠高血壓與子癇前症、妊娠糖尿病、早產與安胎、產程評估與胎心監測判讀、催生與引產、器械助產、剖腹產、產後大出血、肩難產、臍帶脫垂、子癇、羊水栓塞、產後照護與母乳、產科麻醉協作與交班，以師徒工作台方式練習每一步的決策與安全檢查。
introEn: This library covers antenatal care and screening, hypertensive disorders and pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, preterm labour, labour assessment and CTG interpretation, induction, instrumental birth, caesarean section, postpartum haemorrhage, shoulder dystocia, cord prolapse, eclampsia, amniotic fluid embolism, postnatal care and breastfeeding, obstetric anaesthesia teamwork and handover, practised step by step on the mentor workbench.

procedures.title: 產前初診（Booking）：風險評估、篩檢與照護分流
procedures.titleEn: Antenatal booking visit: risk assessment, screening offers and care pathway
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲孕婦，自述懷孕約 10 週，第一次到本院產科門診。產科主治、助產師與門診護理師一起完成初診。本單元教風險辨識、篩檢的告知與照護分流，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old, about 10 weeks by her dates, attending her first antenatal visit here. The obstetric attending, midwife and clinic nurse complete the booking together. Teaches risk recognition, screening offers and care-pathway allocation; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 病史的關鍵
stages.evidence: 助產師問完月經史；住院醫師準備直接開抽血單。
stages.evidenceEn: The midwife has taken the menstrual history; the resident is about to print the blood forms.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先開初診抽血單，病史下次再補
choices.en: Order the booking bloods now; history next time

choices.zh: 完整病史含孕產、家族、用藥與精神
choices.en: Full history: obstetric, medical, family, drugs, mental health

choices.zh: 等 12 週超音波確認後再詳問病史
choices.en: Take the full history after the 12-week scan

stages.reason: 初診是整個孕期風險分層的基礎；許多高風險因子只能靠完整病史發現。
stages.reasonEn: Booking lays the foundation for risk stratification; many high-risk factors are found only by asking.
stages.pitfall: 若略過病史：前次早產或家族血栓史直到出事才被發現。
stages.pitfallEn: Skipping the history means a previous preterm birth or family thrombosis is discovered only when it recurs.

stages.title: 風險分級
stages.evidence: BMI 偏高、母親曾有子癇前症、她本人曾做過子宮頸錐狀切除。
stages.evidenceEn: Raised BMI, her mother had pre-eclampsia, and she herself had a cervical cone excision.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 整體低風險，由助產師主導即可
choices.en: Low risk overall; midwife-led care

choices.zh: 只需控制 BMI，其他因子影響小
choices.en: Only the BMI matters; the rest is minor

choices.zh: 多項中度風險：醫師參與並追蹤頸長
choices.en: Several moderate risks: obstetric input and cervical-length checks

stages.reason: 兩項以上子癇前症中度風險因子應自 12 週起提供低劑量阿斯匹靈；錐切後需早產風險評估。
stages.reasonEn: Two or more moderate pre-eclampsia risk factors warrant low-dose aspirin from 12 weeks; cone excision needs a preterm-birth risk plan.
stages.pitfall: 若歸為低風險：子宮頸縮短在 22 週才被一次急診發現。
stages.pitfallEn: Labelled low risk, a shortening cervix is found only at an emergency visit at 22 weeks.

stages.title: 基礎血壓
stages.evidence: 護理師量到血壓偏高一次；病人剛爬完三層樓梯。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse records one raised reading; the patient has just climbed three flights of stairs.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 記錄為慢性高血壓並轉產科醫師
choices.en: Label it as chronic hypertension and refer her to an obstetrician

choices.zh: 休息後以合適袖帶複測並驗尿蛋白
choices.en: Repeat after rest with the right cuff; check urine protein

choices.zh: 剛爬樓梯，此次數值可直接忽略
choices.en: She just climbed stairs; ignore it

stages.reason: 初診血壓是日後判斷妊娠高血壓的基準；量測誤差會污染整個孕期的比較。
stages.reasonEn: The booking pressure is the baseline against which later hypertension is judged; a sloppy reading contaminates every later comparison.
stages.pitfall: 若基準錯誤：20 週後真正的升高被當成「她本來就高」。
stages.pitfallEn: A wrong baseline lets a real rise after 20 weeks be dismissed as her usual pressure.

stages.title: 感染篩檢的拒絕
stages.evidence: 她同意血型與貧血檢驗，但說「我不需要驗 HIV」。
stages.evidenceEn: She accepts blood group and anaemia tests but says she does not need an HIV test.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 尊重她的拒絕，往後產檢不再提起
choices.en: Respect it and never raise it again

choices.zh: 告知產檢規定 HIV 篩檢為強制項目
choices.en: Tell her HIV testing is compulsory

choices.zh: 說明益處、記錄拒絕並日後再提供
choices.en: Explain the benefit, document the decline and re-offer later

stages.reason: HIV、B 型肝炎與梅毒篩檢讓垂直傳染幾乎可完全預防；拒絕需被記錄且可再提供。
stages.reasonEn: HIV, hepatitis B and syphilis screening makes vertical transmission almost entirely preventable; a decline is documented and re-offered.
stages.pitfall: 若不再提：一位可預防的新生兒感染在產後才被診斷。
stages.pitfallEn: Never re-offered, a preventable neonatal infection is diagnosed after birth.

stages.title: 血型與抗體
stages.evidence: 檢驗：Rh 陰性、抗體篩檢陰性。住院醫師問這代表什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: Results: rhesus negative, antibody screen negative. The resident asks what it means.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 規劃產前抗 D，敏感化事件後補給
choices.en: Plan antenatal anti-D and give it after sensitising events

choices.zh: 抗體篩檢陰性表示無風險，不需處置
choices.en: Negative antibodies mean no risk; nothing needed

choices.zh: 產後確認新生兒血型再決定即可
choices.en: Wait and decide after delivery once the baby's blood group is known

stages.reason: 抗 D 預防把新生兒溶血病的發生率降到極低；每次出血或外傷都是敏感化事件。
stages.reasonEn: Anti-D prophylaxis has made haemolytic disease of the newborn rare; every bleed or abdominal trauma is a sensitising event.
stages.pitfall: 若忘記：下一胎出現胎兒水腫。
stages.pitfallEn: Forgotten, the next pregnancy presents with fetal hydrops.

stages.title: 週數的判定
stages.evidence: 她月經不規則；超音波頭臀長相當於 9 週 4 天，比月經推算少 10 天。
stages.evidenceEn: Her cycles are irregular; the crown-rump length corresponds to 9 weeks 4 days, ten days less than her dates.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 以最後月經推算為準，不需調整
choices.en: Keep the menstrual dates unchanged

choices.zh: 取月經與超音波兩者的平均值
choices.en: Average the two estimates

choices.zh: 依第一孕期頭臀長重新定週數
choices.en: Re-date by first-trimester crown-rump length

stages.reason: 第一孕期超音波是最準確的定期方法；錯誤的週數會使之後的篩檢與催生時機全部偏移。
stages.reasonEn: First-trimester ultrasound is the most accurate dating method; wrong dates shift every later screening window and induction decision.
stages.pitfall: 若沿用月經推算：唐氏症篩檢落在窗口外，39 週催生其實只有 37 週。
stages.pitfallEn: Kept on menstrual dates, aneuploidy screening falls outside its window and a 39-week induction is really 37 weeks.

stages.title: 非整倍體篩檢諮詢
stages.evidence: 她問：「做抽血就知道寶寶有沒有唐氏症嗎？」
stages.evidenceEn: She asks whether a blood test will tell her for certain if the baby has Down syndrome.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 是，NIPT 準確率高即等於確診
choices.en: Yes; NIPT is accurate enough to count as a diagnosis

choices.zh: 抽血是篩檢，確診需絨毛或羊膜穿刺
choices.en: Blood tests screen; diagnosis needs CVS or amniocentesis

choices.zh: 篩檢易造成焦慮，不建議做
choices.en: Screening causes anxiety; not advised

stages.reason: 篩檢給的是機率；侵入性檢查才是診斷，且帶有少量流產風險，必須讓她知情選擇。
stages.reasonEn: Screening gives a probability; invasive testing diagnoses and carries a small miscarriage risk, so the choice must be informed.
stages.pitfall: 若誤以為確診：陽性結果引發不必要的終止決定或錯誤安心。
stages.pitfallEn: Mistaken for a diagnosis, a screen result drives an unnecessary termination decision or false reassurance.

stages.title: 單獨詢問
stages.evidence: 伴侶全程在場並替她回答；助產師想問家庭暴力篩檢。
stages.evidenceEn: Her partner is present throughout and answers for her; the midwife wants to ask about domestic abuse.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 伴侶在場時照常詢問即可
choices.en: Ask as usual with the partner present

choices.zh: 伴侶很關心她，可跳過此題
choices.en: He seems caring; skip the question

choices.zh: 安排至少一次單獨會談再問
choices.en: Arrange to see her alone before asking

stages.reason: 家庭暴力在孕期常升高；只有單獨會談才可能得到真實回答。
stages.reasonEn: Domestic abuse often escalates in pregnancy; only a private conversation can get a truthful answer.
stages.pitfall: 若當面問：她否認，之後再無機會。
stages.pitfallEn: Asked in front of him, she denies it and the chance never comes again.

stages.title: 生活型態衛教
stages.evidence: 她每天抽五根菸，問「少抽一點可以嗎？」
stages.evidenceEn: She smokes five cigarettes a day and asks whether cutting down is enough.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 每天減到兩三根即可接受
choices.en: Two or three a day is acceptable

choices.zh: 提供戒菸轉介並衛教葉酸與食安
choices.en: Cessation referral plus folic acid and food-safety advice

choices.zh: 改用電子菸替代，對胎兒較安全
choices.en: Switch to e-cigarettes instead, which are safer for the baby

stages.reason: 吸菸是可改變的胎兒生長受限與死產風險因子；衛教必須附帶可行的轉介。
stages.reasonEn: Smoking is a modifiable risk factor for growth restriction and stillbirth; advice must come with a practical referral.
stages.pitfall: 若只口頭勸：她到 36 週仍在抽，胎兒體重落到第三百分位。
stages.pitfallEn: Lectured without support, she is still smoking at 36 weeks with the baby on the third centile.

stages.title: 照護路徑
stages.evidence: 病史最後揭露：三年前因胎位不正剖腹產。
stages.evidenceEn: The history finally reveals a caesarean three years ago for breech presentation.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 已過三年，由助產師主導即可
choices.en: Three years ago; midwife-led care is fine

choices.zh: 產科醫師主導，後期討論生產方式
choices.en: Obstetrician-led, discussing birth options later

choices.zh: 前次剖腹，現在就排定再剖腹
choices.en: Book a repeat caesarean now

stages.reason: 前次剖腹產是分流到產科醫師照護的指標；生產方式是知情選擇而非預設。
stages.reasonEn: A previous caesarean allocates her to obstetric-led care; mode of birth is an informed choice, not a default.
stages.pitfall: 若分流錯誤：她在助產師單位陣痛，子宮疤痕的風險沒有人監測。
stages.pitfallEn: Misallocated, she labours in a midwife unit with nobody watching the scar.

stages.title: 紀錄與交班
stages.evidence: 初診結束；護理師問要在手冊上標記什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: Booking ends; the nurse asks what to flag in the handheld notes.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 標記風險、阿斯匹靈與檢查時程
choices.en: Flag risks, aspirin and the visit and scan schedule

choices.zh: 只寫預產期，風險待下次產檢再補
choices.en: Just the due date; risks next time

choices.zh: 病歷已記錄，手冊不需標記
choices.en: It is in the record; no need to flag

stages.reason: 手冊是跨單位的交班工具；未被標記的風險等於不存在。
stages.reasonEn: The handheld record is the handover across settings; an unflagged risk is an invisible one.
stages.pitfall: 若未標記：急診醫師在 30 週看到她時不知道有剖腹產疤痕。
stages.pitfallEn: Unflagged, the ED doctor at 30 weeks has no idea there is a uterine scar.

procedures.title: 非整倍體篩檢與結構性超音波：結果判讀與侵入性檢查諮詢
procedures.titleEn: Aneuploidy screening and the anomaly scan: interpreting results and counselling for invasive testing
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲孕婦，合併篩檢回報高風險；兩個月後另一位孕婦的 20 週結構性超音波發現異常。胎兒醫學主治、超音波師、遺傳諮詢師與你共同處理。本單元教機率判讀、檢查選擇與告知，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 34-year-old whose combined screening returns high chance; two months later another patient's 20-week anomaly scan shows a finding. The fetal medicine attending, sonographer and genetic counsellor work with you. Teaches probability interpretation, test selection and disclosure; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 高風險結果
stages.evidence: 合併篩檢：唐氏症風險 1/80。住院醫師說「寶寶有唐氏症」。
stages.evidenceEn: Combined screening: Down syndrome chance 1 in 80. The resident says the baby has Down syndrome.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 1/80 很高，等同已確診唐氏症
choices.en: 1 in 80 is high enough to be a diagnosis

choices.zh: 高風險篩檢，多數胎兒其實正常
choices.en: A high-chance screen; most such babies are unaffected

choices.zh: 篩檢偽陽性多，結果可忽略
choices.en: False positives are common; ignore it

stages.reason: 1/80 代表 80 位同樣結果的孕婦中約 1 位胎兒受影響；語言錯誤會造成不可逆的決定。
stages.reasonEn: One in 80 means roughly one affected baby among 80 women with the same result; wrong words drive irreversible decisions.
stages.pitfall: 若說成確診：她在未確認前要求終止妊娠。
stages.pitfallEn: Called a diagnosis, she asks to end a pregnancy that was never confirmed.

stages.title: 告知的方式
stages.evidence: 電話告知時她開始哭；背景有小孩在吵。
stages.evidenceEn: She starts crying on the phone; children are shouting in the background.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 趁電話中一次講完所有風險數字
choices.en: Run through all the risk numbers in one go on the phone

choices.zh: 安排遺傳諮詢面談並給書面資料
choices.en: Arrange a prompt genetic counselling visit with written information

choices.zh: 請她先自行上網了解再約門診
choices.en: Ask her to read up online first

stages.reason: 壞消息需要時間、隱私與可追問的對象；書面資料讓她事後能重讀。
stages.reasonEn: Bad news needs time, privacy and someone to question; written material lets her reread it later.
stages.pitfall: 若電話草草結束：她帶著錯誤理解做出決定。
stages.pitfallEn: A rushed call leaves her deciding on a misunderstanding.

stages.title: NIPT 的定位
stages.evidence: 她問能否先做 NIPT 再決定要不要羊膜穿刺。
stages.evidenceEn: She asks whether NIPT can come first, before deciding on amniocentesis.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: NIPT 等同確診，不需再穿刺
choices.en: NIPT is diagnostic; no amniocentesis

choices.zh: 高風險者不可做 NIPT，須直接穿刺
choices.en: After a high-chance result, go straight to amniocentesis

choices.zh: 可以，但陽性仍需侵入性確診
choices.en: Yes, but a positive needs invasive confirmation

stages.reason: NIPT 偵測率極高但仍是篩檢；胎盤嵌合與低胎兒 DNA 比例都可造成假結果。
stages.reasonEn: NIPT has a very high detection rate but remains a screen; placental mosaicism and low fetal fraction cause false results.
stages.pitfall: 若把 NIPT 當確診：胎盤嵌合造成的假陽性導致終止正常胎兒。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as diagnostic, a placental-mosaicism false positive ends a normal pregnancy.

stages.title: 選擇侵入性檢查
stages.evidence: 現在 12 週 5 天；她希望盡快知道結果。
stages.evidenceEn: She is 12 weeks 5 days and wants an answer as soon as possible.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 可做絨毛取樣；羊穿待 15 週後
choices.en: CVS now; amniocentesis only after 15 weeks

choices.zh: 現在就做羊膜穿刺，結果最快最準
choices.en: Amniocentesis now for the quickest result

choices.zh: 兩種檢查都要等 20 週後才安全
choices.en: Both must wait until after 20 weeks

stages.reason: CVS 在 11 週後、羊膜穿刺在 15 週後；過早羊膜穿刺增加流產與足部畸形。
stages.reasonEn: CVS from 11 weeks, amniocentesis from 15 weeks; early amniocentesis raises miscarriage and talipes.
stages.pitfall: 若 13 週做羊膜穿刺：流產率明顯上升。
stages.pitfallEn: Amniocentesis at 13 weeks carries a clearly higher loss rate.

stages.title: 程序安全
stages.evidence: 準備 CVS；病歷顯示她是 Rh 陰性、B 肝帶原。
stages.evidenceEn: Before CVS the chart shows she is rhesus negative and a hepatitis B carrier.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: B 肝帶原為禁忌，應取消檢查
choices.en: Hepatitis B is a contraindication; cancel

choices.zh: 照常進行，Rh 陰性不需處理
choices.en: Proceed; Rh status needs nothing

choices.zh: 超音波導引並事後給抗 D
choices.en: Ultrasound guidance and anti-D afterwards

stages.reason: 侵入性檢查是敏感化事件；B 肝不是禁忌但需被告知。
stages.reasonEn: Invasive testing is a sensitising event; hepatitis B is not a contraindication but must be discussed.
stages.pitfall: 若漏抗 D：她被敏感化，下一胎溶血。
stages.pitfallEn: Without anti-D she is sensitised and the next baby is haemolytic.

stages.title: 同意的內容
stages.evidence: 主治請你取得 CVS 同意。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending asks you to consent her for CVS.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 簽名即可，風險表單上都有寫
choices.en: A signature; the form lists the risks

choices.zh: 說明流產、失敗與嵌合的可能
choices.en: Explain miscarriage risk, failed sampling and mosaicism

choices.zh: 保證結果明確，不會有不確定
choices.en: Promise a clear, certain result

stages.reason: 有效同意包含失敗與不確定結果的可能，不只是流產風險。
stages.reasonEn: Valid consent covers failed and ambiguous results, not only the loss risk.
stages.pitfall: 若未提嵌合：結果曖昧時她覺得被欺騙。
stages.pitfallEn: Mosaicism never mentioned, an ambiguous result feels like a betrayal.

stages.title: 結構性超音波
stages.evidence: 另一位孕婦 20 週：超音波師看到心臟四腔室不對稱、胃泡在右側。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient at 20 weeks: the sonographer sees asymmetrical cardiac chambers and the stomach on the right.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 四腔室輕度不對稱屬正常變異
choices.en: Mild asymmetry is a normal variant

choices.zh: 疑心臟異常，轉胎兒心臟超音波
choices.en: Possible cardiac anomaly: refer for fetal echo

choices.zh: 胎位影響判讀，28 週再複查
choices.en: Fetal position limits the view; rescan at 28 weeks

stages.reason: 心臟異常是結構性超音波最常漏掉的一類；異常內臟位置提高複雜心臟病機率。
stages.reasonEn: Cardiac anomalies are the most commonly missed group at the anomaly scan; abnormal situs raises the chance of complex heart disease.
stages.pitfall: 若等 28 週：錯過確診與產前規劃的窗口。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting until 28 weeks loses the window for diagnosis and delivery planning.

stages.title: 軟指標
stages.evidence: 第三位孕婦：單一脈絡叢囊腫，其他完全正常，篩檢低風險。
stages.evidenceEn: A third patient: an isolated choroid plexus cyst, otherwise normal, low-chance screening.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 孤立脈絡叢囊腫不需進一步檢查
choices.en: An isolated choroid plexus cyst needs no further tests

choices.zh: 需羊膜穿刺排除第 18 對染色體異常
choices.en: She needs amniocentesis to exclude trisomy 18

choices.zh: 告知胎兒可能有嚴重腦部問題
choices.en: Warn her that the baby may have a serious brain problem

stages.reason: 孤立的脈絡叢囊腫在低風險族群不改變非整倍體機率；過度告知造成不必要的焦慮。
stages.reasonEn: An isolated choroid plexus cyst in a low-chance pregnancy does not alter aneuploidy risk; over-disclosure causes needless anxiety.
stages.pitfall: 若過度反應：她接受不必要的侵入性檢查而流產。
stages.pitfallEn: Over-reaction leads to an unnecessary invasive test and a miscarriage.

stages.title: 多專科會議
stages.evidence: 胎兒心臟超音波證實複雜先天性心臟病。
stages.evidenceEn: Fetal echocardiography confirms complex congenital heart disease.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 產科單獨決定，出生後再轉院
choices.en: Obstetrics decides; transfer after birth

choices.zh: 多專科與家長共同規劃出生地點
choices.en: Multidisciplinary team and parents plan place of birth together

choices.zh: 細節太複雜，先不告訴家長
choices.en: Too complex; spare the parents for now

stages.reason: 需要出生後立即介入的胎兒應在有小兒心臟外科的中心出生；家長是團隊的一員。
stages.reasonEn: A baby needing intervention at birth should be born where paediatric cardiac surgery exists; the parents are part of the team.
stages.pitfall: 若在地區醫院出生：新生兒在轉送途中惡化。
stages.pitfallEn: Born in a district hospital, the baby deteriorates during transfer.

stages.title: 後續與交班
stages.evidence: CVS 結果正常；她問之後還要注意什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: The CVS result is normal; she asks what comes next.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 染色體正常，之後不需再追蹤
choices.en: Chromosomes are normal; no more follow-up

choices.zh: 結果正常，只需留意胎動即可
choices.en: All normal; just watch for movements

choices.zh: 仍需結構性超音波與常規產檢
choices.en: The anomaly scan and routine care still apply

stages.reason: 正常染色體不等於結構正常；兩套篩檢互不取代。
stages.reasonEn: Normal chromosomes do not mean normal structure; the two screens are not interchangeable.
stages.pitfall: 若省略結構性超音波：可矯正的腹壁缺損在出生時才被發現。
stages.pitfallEn: Skipping the anomaly scan means a correctable abdominal wall defect is found at birth.

procedures.title: 妊娠高血壓與子癇前症路徑：診斷標準、嚴重特徵與生產時機
procedures.titleEn: Hypertension in pregnancy and the pre-eclampsia pathway: criteria, severe features and timing of birth
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：31 歲初產婦，34 週，產檢時血壓升高並有蛋白尿，被送到產科日間照護單位。產科主治、住院醫師、助產師與麻醉科醫師共同評估。本單元教分類、監測與時機決策，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 31-year-old primigravida at 34 weeks sent to the obstetric day unit with raised blood pressure and proteinuria. The attending, resident, midwife and anaesthetist assess her. Teaches classification, monitoring and timing decisions without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 症狀詢問
stages.evidence: 助產師量到血壓升高；住院醫師只問「有沒有頭痛」。
stages.evidenceEn: The midwife finds a raised pressure; the resident asks only about headache.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 只問頭痛即可，沒頭痛就安全
choices.en: Headache only; none means safe

choices.zh: 系統詢問頭痛、視覺與上腹痛
choices.en: Ask systematically about headache, vision and epigastric pain

choices.zh: 症狀主觀，只看血壓數值即可
choices.en: Symptoms are subjective; just the numbers

stages.reason: 嚴重子癇前症的症狀分散在多個系統；上腹痛是肝臟受累的警訊。
stages.reasonEn: Severe pre-eclampsia symptoms are scattered across systems; epigastric pain signals hepatic involvement.
stages.pitfall: 若漏問上腹痛：HELLP 被當成胃食道逆流送回家。
stages.pitfallEn: Epigastric pain unasked, HELLP goes home as reflux.

stages.title: 複測與尿液
stages.evidence: 15 分鐘後血壓仍在升高範圍；試紙蛋白 2+。
stages.evidenceEn: Fifteen minutes later the pressure remains in the raised range; dipstick protein 2+.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 試紙 2+ 已足以確認蛋白尿
choices.en: Dipstick 2+ confirms proteinuria

choices.zh: 以尿蛋白肌酸酐比值量化並抽血
choices.en: Quantify with a protein-creatinine ratio and send bloods

choices.zh: 試紙 2+ 屬妊娠常見，下次再驗
choices.en: 2+ is common in pregnancy; retest next visit

stages.reason: 試紙假陽性與假陰性都常見；量化蛋白尿是診斷標準的一部分。
stages.reasonEn: Dipstick false positives and negatives are common; quantified proteinuria is part of the diagnostic criteria.
stages.pitfall: 若只憑試紙：診斷錯置，監測強度跟著錯。
stages.pitfallEn: On dipstick alone the diagnosis and the intensity of monitoring are both wrong.

stages.title: 檢驗判讀
stages.evidence: 血小板下降、肝酵素上升、肌酸酐上升；血紅素正常。
stages.evidenceEn: Falling platelets, rising transaminases, rising creatinine; haemoglobin normal.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 檢體溶血造成的實驗室誤差
choices.en: A laboratory error caused by a haemolysed sample

choices.zh: 屬妊娠末期正常生理變化，觀察
choices.en: Normal physiological changes of late pregnancy; observe

choices.zh: 子癇前症且需警覺 HELLP
choices.en: Pre-eclampsia with HELLP a concern

stages.reason: 子癇前症的現代定義是高血壓加任一器官受累，不再要求蛋白尿；血小板與肝酵素趨勢比單一數值重要。
stages.reasonEn: Modern pre-eclampsia is hypertension plus any organ involvement, proteinuria no longer mandatory; trends in platelets and transaminases matter more than one value.
stages.pitfall: 若當誤差：HELLP 在夜裡進展為肝被膜下血腫。
stages.pitfallEn: Dismissed as error, HELLP progresses overnight to a subcapsular liver haematoma.

stages.title: 分類
stages.evidence: 初診血壓正常，現在 34 週高血壓合併蛋白尿與血小板下降。
stages.evidenceEn: Normal pressure at booking, now hypertension at 34 weeks with proteinuria and falling platelets.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 慢性高血壓
choices.en: Chronic hypertension

choices.zh: 妊娠高血壓
choices.en: Gestational hypertension

choices.zh: 子癇前症
choices.en: Pre-eclampsia

stages.reason: 20 週後新發高血壓無器官受累是妊娠高血壓；加上蛋白尿或器官受累即為子癇前症。
stages.reasonEn: New hypertension after 20 weeks without organ involvement is gestational hypertension; with proteinuria or organ involvement it is pre-eclampsia.
stages.pitfall: 若低估為妊娠高血壓：她以門診追蹤的頻率回家。
stages.pitfallEn: Under-classified, she goes home on an outpatient schedule.

stages.title: 胎兒評估
stages.evidence: CTG 正常；上次生長超音波是四週前。
stages.evidenceEn: The CTG is normal; the last growth scan was four weeks ago.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: CTG 正常即可，不需超音波
choices.en: A normal CTG is enough; no ultrasound needed

choices.zh: 安排生長、羊水與臍動脈多普勒
choices.en: Growth, liquor and umbilical artery Doppler scan

choices.zh: 改為每天兩次 CTG 監測即可
choices.en: Switching to twice-daily CTG monitoring is enough

stages.reason: 子癇前症是胎盤疾病；生長受限與多普勒異常改變生產時機。
stages.reasonEn: Pre-eclampsia is a placental disease; growth restriction and abnormal Dopplers change the timing of birth.
stages.pitfall: 若不掃描：胎兒生長受限直到死產才被發現。
stages.pitfallEn: Unscanned, growth restriction is discovered as a stillbirth.

stages.title: 降壓與入院
stages.evidence: 血壓持續升高；住院醫師想開口服降壓藥讓她回家。
stages.evidenceEn: The pressure stays raised; the resident wants to start an oral antihypertensive and send her home.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 入院並開始降壓，監測至目標血壓
choices.en: Admit, start treatment and monitor to a target

choices.zh: 開口服降壓藥讓她回家，一週回診
choices.en: Oral treatment at home, review in a week

choices.zh: 血壓只是數字，不需降壓治療
choices.en: No treatment needed for the numbers

stages.reason: 子癇前症合併異常檢驗需住院評估；降壓是為了預防母體腦血管事件，不是治癒疾病。
stages.reasonEn: Pre-eclampsia with abnormal bloods needs inpatient assessment; treatment protects the mother from cerebrovascular events but does not cure the disease.
stages.pitfall: 若回家：三天後因子癇被救護車送回。
stages.pitfallEn: Sent home, she returns three days later by ambulance after a seizure.

stages.title: 嚴重特徵
stages.evidence: 入院後 6 小時：嚴重頭痛、視力模糊、反射亢進、尿量減少。
stages.evidenceEn: Six hours after admission: severe headache, blurred vision, brisk reflexes, falling urine output.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 給止痛藥並觀察頭痛是否緩解
choices.en: Analgesia and see if the headache settles

choices.zh: 啟動硫酸鎂預防子癇並呼叫主治
choices.en: Start magnesium sulfate and call the attending and anaesthetist

choices.zh: 立即推入手術室緊急剖腹產
choices.en: Straight to theatre for caesarean

stages.reason: 神經症狀與反射亢進是子癇前驅；穩定母體永遠優先於生產。
stages.reasonEn: Neurological symptoms and hyperreflexia herald eclampsia; stabilising the mother always comes before birth.
stages.pitfall: 若先衝進手術室：她在麻醉誘導時抽搐。
stages.pitfallEn: Rushed to theatre unstabilised, she seizes at induction.

stages.title: 生產時機
stages.evidence: 34 週 3 天，母體穩定後；血小板持續下降。
stages.evidenceEn: At 34 weeks 3 days, mother stabilised, platelets still falling.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 母體已穩定，延長至 37 週再生產
choices.en: She is stable; continue to 37 weeks

choices.zh: 已過 34 週且進展：規劃生產
choices.en: Progressive beyond 34 weeks: plan birth

choices.zh: 給類固醇後期待至 40 週
choices.en: Steroids, then wait until 40 weeks

stages.reason: 34 週後嚴重或進展中的子癇前症以生產為治療；34 週前則權衡延長妊娠的胎兒利益。
stages.reasonEn: After 34 weeks, severe or progressive pre-eclampsia is treated by birth; before 34 weeks the fetal gain from prolonging is weighed.
stages.pitfall: 若硬等 37 週：胎盤早期剝離或子癇。
stages.pitfallEn: Forced to 37 weeks, she abrupts or seizes.

stages.title: 生產方式
stages.evidence: 子宮頸閉合、胎頭高；住院醫師認為一定要剖腹產。
stages.evidenceEn: Cervix closed, head high; the resident assumes caesarean is mandatory.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 子癇前症病人一律以剖腹產為安全
choices.en: Pre-eclampsia always makes caesarean the safer route

choices.zh: 依產科狀況決定，催生是合理選項
choices.en: Decide on obstetric grounds; induction is reasonable

choices.zh: 等自然陣痛，避免催生加重病情
choices.en: Wait for spontaneous labour, since induction worsens the disease

stages.reason: 子癇前症本身不是剖腹產的適應症；生產方式由子宮頸、胎兒狀況與緊急程度決定。
stages.reasonEn: Pre-eclampsia itself is not an indication for caesarean; mode depends on the cervix, fetal condition and urgency.
stages.pitfall: 若一律剖腹：母體承受不必要的手術與出血風險。
stages.pitfallEn: Reflex caesarean adds surgical and haemorrhage risk the mother did not need.

stages.title: 麻醉與團隊
stages.evidence: 麻醉科醫師問血小板與凝血狀況，以及輸液計畫。
stages.evidenceEn: The anaesthetist asks about platelets, coagulation and the fluid plan.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 血小板足夠優先區域麻醉並限制輸液
choices.en: Regional if platelets allow; restrict fluids

choices.zh: 積極大量輸液維持尿量，保護腎功能
choices.en: Generous fluids to keep urine flowing

choices.zh: 子癇前症一律全身麻醉較安全
choices.en: General anaesthesia is always safer here

stages.reason: 子癇前症血管滲漏，過量輸液是肺水腫與死亡的主因之一；全身麻醉的插管高血壓反應也危險。
stages.reasonEn: Pre-eclampsia leaks capillaries, so fluid overload is a leading cause of pulmonary oedema and death; the pressor response to intubation is also dangerous.
stages.pitfall: 若大量輸液：產後第一天肺水腫插管。
stages.pitfallEn: Flooded, she is intubated for pulmonary oedema on day one.

stages.title: 產後追蹤
stages.evidence: 產後第 3 天血壓仍高；她問什麼時候可以停藥。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 3 postpartum the pressure is still raised; she asks when she can stop the tablets.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 產後血壓會自然恢復，出院即停藥
choices.en: Pressure normalises after birth; stop at discharge

choices.zh: 逐步減藥並說明長期心血管風險
choices.en: Taper gradually and explain long-term cardiovascular risk

choices.zh: 血壓正常後即可結案，不需追蹤
choices.en: Once normal, discharge with no follow-up

stages.reason: 產後血壓常在第 3 至 6 天達高峰；子癇前症病史使日後高血壓與心血管疾病風險加倍。
stages.reasonEn: Postpartum pressure often peaks on days 3 to 6; a history of pre-eclampsia roughly doubles later hypertension and cardiovascular risk.
stages.pitfall: 若停藥出院：產後第 5 天發生子癇。
stages.pitfallEn: Stopped at discharge, she has a postpartum seizure on day 5.

stages.title: 交班
stages.evidence: 夜班助產師接手；病人正在使用硫酸鎂。
stages.evidenceEn: The night midwife takes over; the patient is on magnesium sulfate.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 口頭交代「血壓高的那位」即可
choices.en: Say she is the high blood pressure one

choices.zh: 交鎂毒性徵象與監測頻率
choices.en: Hand over toxicity signs and monitoring frequency

choices.zh: 寫在護理站白板，夜班自行查看
choices.en: Write it on the board for nights

stages.reason: 硫酸鎂的安全依賴反射、呼吸與尿量監測；交班斷層是毒性被漏掉的常見原因。
stages.reasonEn: Magnesium safety depends on reflex, respiratory and urine monitoring; handover gaps are a common reason toxicity is missed.
stages.pitfall: 若交班不清：反射消失六小時沒人注意。
stages.pitfallEn: Handed over vaguely, absent reflexes go unnoticed for six hours.

procedures.title: 子癇急症：抽搐處置、穩定母體與生產時機
procedures.titleEn: Eclampsia: seizure management, maternal stabilisation and timing of birth
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：27 歲孕婦，36 週，在產前病房突然全身抽搐。產科主治、住院醫師、助產師、麻醉科與新生兒科團隊啟動急救。本單元教抽搐期的安全、穩定順序與團隊角色，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 27-year-old at 36 weeks has a generalised seizure on the antenatal ward. The obstetric attending, resident, midwife, anaesthetist and neonatal team respond. Teaches seizure safety, the order of stabilisation and team roles without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 抽搐的第一分鐘
stages.titleEn: The first minute of the seizure
stages.evidence: 她在床上全身強直陣攣；住院醫師想壓住她的四肢。
stages.evidenceEn: She is having a tonic-clonic seizure in bed; the resident tries to hold her limbs down.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 用力壓住四肢，避免抽搐中受傷
choices.en: Hold the limbs down to prevent injury

choices.zh: 撬開牙關放入口咬器，防止咬舌
choices.en: Force a bite block in to protect the tongue

choices.zh: 側臥、拉床欄、移開危險物並呼救
choices.en: Lateral, rails up, clear hazards, call for help

stages.reason: 多數子癇抽搐在數分鐘內自限；側臥防止吸入並減少主動脈下腔靜脈壓迫。
stages.reasonEn: Most eclamptic seizures self-terminate within minutes; the lateral position prevents aspiration and relieves aortocaval compression.
stages.pitfall: 若壓制或塞東西：牙齒斷裂、吸入性肺炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Restraint or a forced object breaks teeth and causes aspiration.

stages.title: 呼叫的內容
stages.evidence: 助產師按下緊急鈴；問你要叫誰。
stages.evidenceEn: The midwife presses the emergency bell and asks who to call.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 先叫住院醫師，評估後再升級
choices.en: The resident first; escalate later

choices.zh: 叫產科主治、麻醉與新生兒團隊
choices.en: Obstetric attending, anaesthetist and neonatal team

choices.zh: 等抽搐停止確認診斷後再呼叫
choices.en: Call once it stops and is confirmed

stages.reason: 子癇是母體急症；麻醉科負責氣道，新生兒科為可能的緊急生產待命。
stages.reasonEn: Eclampsia is a maternal emergency; anaesthesia owns the airway and neonatology stands by for a possible urgent birth.
stages.pitfall: 若只叫一人：抽搐停止後呼吸道阻塞沒人處理。
stages.pitfallEn: Called alone, nobody manages the airway when the seizure stops.

stages.title: 抽搐後的氣道
stages.evidence: 抽搐停止，她昏睡、打呼、SpO2 下降。
stages.evidenceEn: The seizure stops; she is drowsy, snoring, saturation falling.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 抽搐已停，讓她平躺休息觀察
choices.en: It has stopped; lie her flat to rest

choices.zh: 側臥抬頷、給氧抽吸，麻醉評估
choices.en: Lateral, jaw thrust, oxygen and suction; anaesthetic review

choices.zh: 立即由住院醫師插管保護氣道
choices.en: Resident intubates now to protect the airway

stages.reason: 多數病人以基本氣道手法即可恢復；插管決定屬於麻醉科並視反應而定。
stages.reasonEn: Most patients recover with basic airway manoeuvres; intubation is an anaesthetic decision based on response.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：缺氧造成母體與胎兒心搏過緩。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting lets hypoxia produce maternal and fetal bradycardia.

stages.title: 止痙與預防
stages.evidence: 主治問要用什麼預防再次抽搐。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending asks what to give to prevent recurrence.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 以傳統抗癲癇藥物預防再抽搐
choices.en: A conventional anticonvulsant to prevent recurrence

choices.zh: 首選硫酸鎂並監測反射與呼吸
choices.en: Magnesium sulfate first line, monitoring reflexes and breathing

choices.zh: 已停止抽搐，不需預防性用藥
choices.en: It has stopped; no prophylaxis

stages.reason: 硫酸鎂在子癇的再發預防優於其他藥物；其毒性以反射消失為最早徵象。
stages.reasonEn: Magnesium sulfate outperforms other agents for recurrence; loss of reflexes is the earliest sign of toxicity.
stages.pitfall: 若用傳統抗癲癇藥：再次抽搐機率明顯較高。
stages.pitfallEn: On a conventional anticonvulsant, recurrence is clearly more likely.

stages.title: 鎂毒性
stages.evidence: 兩小時後：膝反射消失、呼吸每分鐘 10 次、尿量少。
stages.evidenceEn: Two hours later: knee reflexes absent, respiratory rate 10, scanty urine.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 反射消失表示有效，繼續輸注
choices.en: Absent reflexes mean it works; continue

choices.zh: 停止輸注、呼叫麻醉並備鈣劑
choices.en: Stop the infusion, call anaesthesia, have calcium ready

choices.zh: 加快輸注速度以防再次抽搐
choices.en: Speed up the infusion to prevent another seizure from happening

stages.reason: 腎功能受損使鎂累積；反射消失先於呼吸抑制，是停止的訊號。
stages.reasonEn: Impaired renal function lets magnesium accumulate; lost reflexes precede respiratory depression and are the signal to stop.
stages.pitfall: 若繼續：呼吸停止。
stages.pitfallEn: Continued, she stops breathing.

stages.title: 血壓控制
stages.evidence: 血壓在嚴重範圍；住院醫師想一次把血壓壓到正常。
stages.evidenceEn: The pressure is in the severe range; the resident wants to normalise it in one step.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 緩步降至安全目標，避免驟降
choices.en: Lower gradually to a safe target; avoid a sudden drop

choices.zh: 快速降至正常，減少腦出血風險
choices.en: Bring it to normal fast to prevent stroke

choices.zh: 抽搐已控制，血壓可暫不處理
choices.en: Seizure controlled; leave the pressure

stages.reason: 嚴重高血壓增加腦出血風險，但驟降會造成胎兒窘迫。
stages.reasonEn: Severe hypertension risks intracerebral haemorrhage, but a precipitous fall causes fetal distress.
stages.pitfall: 若驟降：CTG 出現延長減速。
stages.pitfallEn: Dropped too fast, the CTG shows a prolonged deceleration.

stages.title: 胎兒評估
stages.evidence: 抽搐後 CTG：基線心搏過緩 5 分鐘後恢復，變異性減少。
stages.evidenceEn: After the seizure the CTG shows a bradycardia recovering after five minutes, with reduced variability.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 胎兒心搏過緩，立即緊急剖腹產
choices.en: Fetal bradycardia: immediate caesarean

choices.zh: 先穩定母體再評估胎兒
choices.en: Stabilise the mother, then reassess

choices.zh: 抽搐後 CTG 不可信，可忽略
choices.en: CTG after a seizure is unreliable; ignore it

stages.reason: 抽搐中的胎兒心搏過緩反映母體缺氧與子宮過度收縮；母體穩定後通常恢復。
stages.reasonEn: Fetal bradycardia during a seizure reflects maternal hypoxia and uterine hypertonus; it usually recovers once the mother is stable.
stages.pitfall: 若立刻開刀：在未穩定的母體進行全身麻醉，風險轉移到母親。
stages.pitfallEn: Operating at once shifts the danger to an unstabilised mother under general anaesthesia.

stages.title: 生產時機
stages.evidence: 母體穩定、無再抽搐、CTG 恢復正常。
stages.evidenceEn: Mother stable, no further seizures, CTG back to normal.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 母體穩定，可期待至 37 週
choices.en: Stable now; continue to 37 weeks

choices.zh: 穩定後規劃生產，方式依產科狀況
choices.en: Plan birth once stable; mode by obstetric factors

choices.zh: 無再抽搐即可出院，門診追蹤
choices.en: No more seizures; discharge with follow-up

stages.reason: 子癇後唯一的根治是生產，但只在母體穩定後進行。
stages.reasonEn: After eclampsia the only cure is birth, undertaken only once the mother is stable.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：再次抽搐或胎盤早期剝離。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting invites another seizure or an abruption.

stages.title: 麻醉決策
stages.evidence: 決定剖腹產；血小板足夠、意識清楚；麻醉科問選擇。
stages.evidenceEn: Caesarean decided; platelets adequate, fully conscious; the anaesthetist asks about the technique.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 清醒且凝血正常可脊椎麻醉
choices.en: Spinal is reasonable if alert with normal clotting

choices.zh: 子癇後一律全身麻醉較安全
choices.en: After eclampsia, general anaesthesia is always the safer choice

choices.zh: 產科自行決定，不需麻醉會診
choices.en: Obstetrics decides; no anaesthetic input

stages.reason: 區域麻醉避免插管時的高血壓風暴與困難氣道；意識不清或凝血異常才需全身麻醉。
stages.reasonEn: Regional anaesthesia avoids the hypertensive surge and difficult airway of intubation; general anaesthesia is for impaired consciousness or coagulopathy.
stages.pitfall: 若未控制插管反應：腦出血。
stages.pitfallEn: An unblunted intubation response causes intracerebral haemorrhage.

stages.title: 產後監測
stages.evidence: 產後第 1 天在高依賴單位；助產師問硫酸鎂要用到何時。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 1 in the high-dependency unit; the midwife asks how long magnesium continues.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 生產即治癒子癇，產後可立即停用
choices.en: Birth cures eclampsia; stop straight after

choices.zh: 產後與末次抽搐後皆滿 24 小時
choices.en: Until 24 hours after both birth and the last seizure

choices.zh: 持續一週以防晚發型抽搐
choices.en: Continue a week against late seizures

stages.reason: 產後子癇常見；血壓與神經症狀監測需延續到產後數日。
stages.reasonEn: Postpartum eclampsia is common; pressure and neurological monitoring must continue for days.
stages.pitfall: 若產後即停：第 2 天在病房再抽搐。
stages.pitfallEn: Stopped at birth, she seizes again on the ward on day 2.

stages.title: 鑑別診斷
stages.evidence: 另一位產婦產後第 4 天抽搐，血壓正常、無蛋白尿、劇烈頭痛三天。
stages.evidenceEn: Another woman seizes on day 4 postpartum: normal pressure, no proteinuria, three days of severe headache.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 典型產後子癇，給硫酸鎂即可
choices.en: Typical late postpartum eclampsia; magnesium sulphate alone is enough

choices.zh: 不典型：安排腦部影像排除他因
choices.en: Atypical: brain imaging to exclude other causes

choices.zh: 產後疲勞與失眠，給安眠藥
choices.en: Exhaustion and insomnia; give a hypnotic

stages.reason: 產後抽搐先按子癇給硫酸鎂穩定；因表現不典型，同時影像排除靜脈栓塞、出血與 RCVS。
stages.reasonEn: Treat a postpartum seizure as eclampsia with magnesium first; as it is atypical, image to exclude venous thrombosis, haemorrhage and RCVS.
stages.pitfall: 若只當子癇不做影像：腦靜脈栓塞未被抗凝。
stages.pitfallEn: Labelled eclampsia without imaging, a venous thrombosis goes unanticoagulated.

stages.title: 紀錄與回顧
stages.evidence: 事件結束；團隊疲憊，主治召集所有人。
stages.evidenceEn: The event is over; the team is exhausted and the attending gathers everyone.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 大家很累，各自回去休息工作
choices.en: Everyone is tired; back to work

choices.zh: 即時記錄時間線並結構化回顧
choices.en: Record the timeline now and debrief

choices.zh: 明天精神好時再補寫紀錄
choices.en: Write it up tomorrow when rested

stages.reason: 即時紀錄保護病人與團隊；回顧是把一次急救變成下一次改進的唯一方法。
stages.reasonEn: Contemporaneous notes protect patient and team; the debrief is the only way one emergency improves the next.
stages.pitfall: 若不回顧：同樣的呼叫延誤下個月重演。
stages.pitfallEn: Without a debrief the same delayed call recurs next month.

procedures.title: 妊娠糖尿病路徑：篩檢、血糖目標、生長監測與生產時機
procedures.titleEn: Gestational diabetes pathway: screening, glucose targets, growth surveillance and timing of birth
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：33 歲孕婦，前胎巨嬰、BMI 偏高，26 週口服葡萄糖耐量試驗符合妊娠糖尿病標準。產科主治、糖尿病衛教師、營養師與助產師共同照護。本單元教篩檢邏輯、治療階梯原則與時機決策，不含藥物劑量與血糖數值，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 33-year-old with a previous macrosomic baby and raised BMI whose 26-week glucose tolerance test meets criteria for gestational diabetes. The attending, diabetes educator, dietitian and midwife share her care. Teaches screening logic, the treatment ladder in principle and timing decisions without doses or glucose numbers; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 早產陣痛：診斷、產前類固醇與硫酸鎂神經保護的決策原則
procedures.titleEn: Threatened preterm labour: diagnosis and the decision principles for antenatal corticosteroids and magnesium neuroprotection
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：25 歲孕婦，30 週，規則腹痛三小時到產房。產科主治、住院醫師、助產師與新生兒科醫師共同處理。本單元教早產陣痛的診斷工具、類固醇與鎂的時機原則與轉院決策，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 25-year-old at 30 weeks arrives on labour ward with three hours of regular pains. The attending, resident, midwife and neonatologist manage her. Teaches diagnostic tools for preterm labour, the timing principles of steroids and magnesium, and transfer decisions without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 早產期胎膜早破（PPROM）：診斷、感染監測與生產時機
procedures.titleEn: Preterm prelabour rupture of membranes: diagnosis, infection surveillance and timing of birth
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲孕婦，31 週，自述大量清澈液體流出兩小時。產科主治、住院醫師、助產師與新生兒科共同照護。本單元教診斷、避免醫源性感染、監測與時機原則，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old at 31 weeks reporting a gush of clear fluid two hours ago. The attending, resident, midwife and neonatal team share her care. Teaches diagnosis, avoiding iatrogenic infection, surveillance and timing principles without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 產前出血：前置胎盤與胎盤早期剝離的辨識、大量出血呼叫與生產決策
procedures.titleEn: Antepartum haemorrhage: recognising placenta praevia and abruption, the major haemorrhage call and the decision to deliver
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：35 歲孕婦，33 週，前次剖腹產，陰道大量鮮血送到產房；稍後另一位孕婦以劇烈腹痛與木板樣子宮到院。產科主治、住院醫師、助產師、麻醉科、血庫與新生兒科共同處理。本單元教禁忌動作、鑑別、呼叫與時機決策，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 35-year-old at 33 weeks with a previous caesarean arrives with heavy fresh vaginal bleeding; later another woman presents with severe pain and a woody uterus. The attending, resident, midwife, anaesthetist, blood bank and neonatal team respond. Teaches forbidden actions, differentiation, the call and timing decisions without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 前置胎盤與植入性胎盤

procedures.title: 胎動減少與死產預防：評估、風險分層與時機決策
procedures.titleEn: Reduced fetal movements and stillbirth prevention: assessment, risk stratification and timing decisions
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：30 歲孕婦，37 週，第二次因胎動減少到產科評估單位。產科主治、助產師與超音波師共同評估。本單元教胎動的評估、死產風險因子的整合與時機決策，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 30-year-old at 37 weeks attending the maternity assessment unit for the second time with reduced fetal movements. The attending, midwife and sonographer assess her. Teaches movement assessment, integrating stillbirth risk factors and timing decisions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 孕產期靜脈血栓栓塞：風險評估、預防原則與疑似肺栓塞的處理
procedures.titleEn: Venous thromboembolism in pregnancy: risk assessment, prophylaxis principles and the suspected pulmonary embolus
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：38 歲孕婦，BMI 偏高、雙胞胎妊娠、剛接受緊急剖腹產；產後第 3 天突發呼吸困難與胸痛。產科主治、住院醫師、麻醉科、放射科與血液科共同處理。本單元教風險評分、預防原則與診斷路徑，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 38-year-old with raised BMI and a twin pregnancy who has just had an emergency caesarean, then develops sudden breathlessness and chest pain on day 3. The attending, resident, anaesthetist, radiologist and haematologist manage her. Teaches risk scoring, prophylaxis principles and the diagnostic pathway without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 產程評估與產程圖：潛伏期與活動期、延遲的定義與處置
procedures.titleEn: Labour assessment and the partogram: latent and established labour, defining and managing delay
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：26 歲初產婦，39 週，規則宮縮六小時到產房。助產師主責，產科住院醫師與主治在延遲時加入。本單元教如何判定產程階段、使用產程圖與辨識延遲，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 26-year-old primigravida at 39 weeks arriving with six hours of regular contractions. The midwife leads, with the resident and attending joining when labour slows. Teaches staging labour, using the partogram and recognising delay without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 人工破水與催產素原則

procedures.title: 胎心監測（CTG）判讀與升級：DR C BRAVADO 與 NICE 分類
procedures.titleEn: CTG interpretation and escalation: DR C BRAVADO and NICE categorisation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：32 歲經產婦，41 週催生中，使用催產素。助產師、住院醫師與產科主治輪流看同一條 CTG。本單元教結構化判讀、情境整合與何時升級，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 32-year-old multigravida at 41 weeks being induced on oxytocin. The midwife, resident and attending each read the same trace. Teaches structured interpretation, integrating context and when to escalate without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 催生：適應症、Bishop 評分、方法原則與子宮過度刺激
procedures.titleEn: Induction of labour: indications, Bishop score, methods in principle and uterine hyperstimulation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲初產婦，41 週 3 天，安排催生；另一位前次剖腹產的產婦同日入院。產科主治、住院醫師與助產師共同執行。本單元教適應症、子宮頸評估、方法選擇的原則與過度刺激的處理，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 34-year-old primigravida at 41 weeks 3 days booked for induction; a woman with a previous caesarean is admitted the same day. The attending, resident and midwife run the process. Teaches indications, cervical assessment, choice of method in principle and managing hyperstimulation without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 產婦要求硬膜外止痛：評估、禁忌、團隊協作與併發症辨識
procedures.titleEn: The epidural request: assessment, contraindications, teamwork and complication recognition
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：28 歲初產婦，活動期 5 公分，要求硬膜外止痛。助產師、產科住院醫師與產科麻醉科醫師共同處理。本單元教請求的評估、禁忌辨識、協作與併發症，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 28-year-old primigravida at 5 cm asking for an epidural. The midwife, obstetric resident and obstetric anaesthetist work together. Teaches assessment of the request, contraindications, cooperation and complications without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 器械助產：先決條件、真空吸引與產鉗的選擇與放棄時機
procedures.titleEn: Assisted vaginal birth: prerequisites, ventouse-versus-forceps choice and when to abandon
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：30 歲初產婦，第二產程主動用力兩小時，胎頭站位 +2、枕前位、母體疲憊。產科主治、住院醫師、助產師、麻醉科與新生兒科參與。本單元教先決條件、器械選擇、安全停損與新生兒交接，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 30-year-old primigravida after two hours of active pushing, station plus 2, occipito-anterior, exhausted. The attending, resident, midwife, anaesthetist and neonatal team take part. Teaches prerequisites, instrument choice, safe stopping rules and neonatal handover; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 會陰撕裂：分級、肛門括約肌損傷的辨識與修補原則
procedures.titleEn: Perineal tears: classification, recognising obstetric anal sphincter injury and repair principles
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：27 歲初產婦，自然產 3.9 公斤嬰兒後會陰撕裂。助產師、產科住院醫師與主治共同評估與修補，物理治療師參與追蹤。本單元教分級、系統性檢查與修補原則，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 27-year-old primigravida with a perineal tear after the spontaneous birth of a 3.9 kg baby. procedures.titleEn: Pelvic floor function after childbirth
procedures.patient: 依課程「生產後骨盆底與日常功能」設定的虛擬情境：詢問漏尿與墜脹；比較疼痛與活動限制；規劃復健與再評估。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Pelvic floor function after childbirth": Ask about leakage and heaviness; Compare pain and activity limits; Plan rehabilitation and reassessment. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
